offers.name: MSI Katana 15 HX Gaming Laptop, 15.6" 165Hz WQHD IPS Display, 14th Intel i7-14650HX 16-Core, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060, 32GB DDR5 1TB SSD, RGB Backlit KB, HD Camera, Win11 Home

praises: 32GB from the factory at ~$2,640 — rare in the budget tier; good for heavy multitasking and VMs
QHD 165Hz panel beats FHD panels on most budget rivals
Two SO-DIMM + two M.2 slots: upgrades remain cheap even after purchase
RTX 5060 with DLSS 4 handles QHD gaming at medium-high settings
complaints: Plastic chassis with deck flex — clear step down from Vector
720p webcam, no privacy shutter, weak speakers
Audible fan under gaming; middling deck temps
Poor battery (~3-4h light) from the power-hungry 14th-gen HX
MSI Center bloat; marketplace anchor pricing inflates the apparent discount

design_philosophy: The Katana is MSI's budget gaming line: carry-over 14th-gen HX CPUs and a plastic chassis paired with current RTX 50 silicon at the lowest prices in the category. This 32GB variant targets buyers who want multitasking headroom without paying step-up-tier prices.
